name: Hime-sama Hakudaku Lesson ~Sutte Shigoite Namete Hasande Shimetsukete Atsui no Uketomechau~
original_name: 姫さま白濁レッスン ～スってシゴいて舐めて挟んで締め付けて熱いの受けとめちゃう～
source:
Teach a pure princess the life of commoner.
She does not know anything so she accepts any humiliation.

Training of a pure girl. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052282.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
教导纯洁的公主平民的生活。
她什么都不知道，所以她接受任何羞辱。

清纯少女的调教。
